summary: First iteration testing of SAP BOM Lookup app. Executed 7 pytest backend cases (root, connection-status, valid BOM search 8060522_1, invalid BOM 404, missing/empty query 422, whitespace trimming) — all passed. Ran full Playwright E2E on the public URL: app loads, empty state visible, submit disabled when empty, 'SAP Connected' status resolves, invalid BOM shows error alert with 'not found' message, valid BOM search shows loading skeleton, results table with 10 rows/2 groups, all 4 stat cards update, active Yes badges render, success toast fires. No blocking issues found.

issues: 'Line Item' column displays group.group_number (same value as Group column, e.g. 10/10 or 20/20 repeated for every row). It likely should show a per-component line/sequence identifier so each row is distinguishable — currently every row in a group looks identical in the first two columns.

'Material ID' shows the same value (8060522) for all 10 rows across both groups. Backend falls back to MaterialUUID when InternalID is missing; verify that InternalID is being extracted from the correct OData field (variant.InternalID) since identical material IDs across all components is unusual and may indicate a mapping issue in sap_client.get_component_details.

action_items: Consider surfacing a per-item line number in the results table instead of duplicating the group number under 'Line Item'.
Verify SAP field mapping for Material ID — all rows returning identical '8060522' is suspicious; confirm variant.InternalID vs MaterialUUID mapping is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: sap_client.search_bom relies on positional zipping between hierarchy items and component change-states. If SAP ever returns details in a different order or with a different count than hierarchy item_ids, rows will silently mis-align. Consider adding a length assertion/log-warning and/or a stable key-based join if any shared key exists.
server.py instantiates SAPBOMClient at import time using os.environ[...] which will crash the process on missing env vars; acceptable for fail-fast but consider a clearer startup error message.
seed_data_creation: None — no DB, all data live from SAP
test_credentials: N/A - app has no auth. SAP creds already in backend/.env.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows verified against public URL. Two data-quality observations left for main agent: (a) Line Item column duplicates group id, (b) Material ID identical across all rows — both may be legitimate SAP data quirks for BOM 8060522_1 but worth confirming.
rca_of_the_issue: No blocking defect. Design observations only.
